title: Page: from 20 s, about 14% of requests fail. Latency does not change.
explain: One in five requests to the database returns an error (for example, a connection reset). Every instance does the same. Errors come back fast, so latency does not change; only the error rate goes up. Users see failed reads. One in five of the worker's writes to the database fails too: that background work is not done, but the users' error rate does not show it. You must open the queue's metrics to see it.
hint: Retries stop random errors: set 2 retries on API → db and on worker → db. If you fix only the API connection, the background work still loses one job in five.
